annotations.text:
Gradient canvas, frosted cards.

Structure borrowed from your UserBoost dashboard — fixed 180° gradient, glass surfaces at 55–68% white, hairlines at 8% ink, page title on the dark band. Retuned for a disk library rather than reusing UserBoost's brand: Space Grotesk + IBM Plex Mono instead of Inter, and the accent set is navy for actions, blue for counts, amber for attention.

The dark top does real work here — cover art reads as sitting on a shelf.

One disk in the drive at a time (D10).

Disk 1 is green and IN DRIVE; the rest say SWAP TO. Clicking one queues a mount job — about 2 s to re-fetch and re-enumerate USB.

Every finished row has a MOUNT button (D9).

Drop, click, play — you never have to visit the library for a disk you just uploaded and already know you want.

Not chosen — kept for the record.

Three dark directions and a flat light one. The flat light version is the same layout as the live design without the gradient canvas, which is the comparison that settled it.
